supportTickets.subject: Barcode scanner camera illumination in low light aisles
supportTickets.message: Could the torch button stay on while scanning multiple items consecutively?
supportTickets.reply: Thanks Brian! We have updated the scanner with a persistent torch toggle button and offline cache.

supportTickets.subject: Clarification on flagging damaged product barcodes
supportTickets.message: When a shopper brings a product with a ripped barcode, how should cashier note it?
supportTickets.reply: Staff can tap "Flag Mismatch" and select "Damaged goods / Unreadable barcode".
